## What this changes and why

## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .` and `uv run pytest` pass.
- [ ] A change to a rule or a number also changes `docs/spec.md`, `SPEC_VERSION` and `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] A change to a check was run on a real engine; the PR says which engine, version and assets.
- [ ] Comments follow "How we write comments" in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
